authority.scope: Read-only confirmation of GTK2 runtime and RC search inputs for the current user's XChat processes.

interpretation: Both inspected XChat processes are GTK2 2.24.33 and include the selected user's ~/.gtkrc-2.0 in GTK2_RC_FILES. That file selects DomainOS-SR10-4-KDE, whose installed copies remain older per R320. This proves the process configuration path, not which pixmap bytes were cached in memory or the exact pixels currently drawn.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: Confirmed the actual XChat runtime follows the stale GTK2 profile files; pixel-level live-app comparison and historical review remain open.

next_step: After MAME process ownership is resolved and the VUE target is visible, finish the native historical comparison. Then, if the authorized GTK2 recipe passes, apply the user-local update and restart only the application chosen for review.
